---
title: "Profiling: Method Execution Speed"
format: pdf
---

```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

```{r profiling-config}
# Times each method is run per multiverse; the median is reported, with the
# min/max shown as a range. Raise for more stable estimates at the cost of a
# slower render.
N_RUNS <- 3
```

## Profiling harness

```{r profiling-harness}
profile_multiverse <- function (mv, colname_metric,
                                model_pre_process = identity,
                                include_fanova_total = TRUE,
                                n_runs = 3) {
  model_mv <- model_pre_process(mv)

  runners <- list(
    regression  = function () calc_regression_importance(model_mv, colname_metric),
    fanova_main = function () calc_fanova_main_importance(model_mv, colname_metric),
    decide      = function () calc_decide_importances(mv, colname_metric)
  )

  if (include_fanova_total) {
    runners$fanova_total <- function () {
      calc_fanova_total_importance(model_mv, colname_metric)
    }
  }

  imap_dfr(runners, function (run, method) {
    timings <- vapply(
      seq_len(n_runs),
      function (i) unname(system.time(run())[["elapsed"]]),
      numeric(1)
    )
    tibble(
      method = method,
      time_median = median(timings),
      time_min = min(timings),
      time_max = max(timings),
      n_runs = n_runs
    )
  })
}

fmt_time <- function (seconds) {
  if_else(
    seconds < 1,
    sprintf("%.0f ms", seconds * 1000),
    sprintf("%.1f s", seconds)
  )
}
```

## Multiverses

```{r profiling-load-data}
set.seed(42)

multiverses <- list(
  "Fertility"        = load_multiverse("fertility"),
  "Hurricane"        = load_multiverse("hurricane"),
  "YRBS"       = load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_yrbs"),
  "MTF"        = load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mtf"),
  "MCS"  = load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mcs_total")
)

multiverse_levels <- names(multiverses)

specs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~multiverse,        ~colname_metric,          ~model_pre_process,   ~include_fanova_total,
  "Fertility",        "fertility_low_estimate", "identity",           TRUE,
  "Hurricane",        "expected_deaths_diff",   "identity",           TRUE,
  "YRBS",       "effect",                 "expand_y_variable",  TRUE,
  "MTF",        "effect",                 "expand_y_variable",  FALSE,
  "MCS",  "effect",                 "expand_y_variable",  FALSE
)
```

```{r profiling-multiverse-overview}
mv_meta <- specs |>
  mutate(
    n_universes = map_int(multiverse, ~ nrow(multiverses[[.x]])),
    n_decisions = map_int(multiverse, ~ length(get_multiverse_decisions(multiverses[[.x]]))),
    n_decisions_model = map2_int(
      multiverse, model_pre_process,
      ~ length(get_multiverse_decisions(get(.y)(multiverses[[.x]])))
    )
  )

mv_meta |>
  select(multiverse, colname_metric, n_universes, n_decisions,
         n_decisions_model, include_fanova_total)
```

## Run profiling

```{r profiling-run}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
profiling_results <- specs |>
  pmap_dfr(function (multiverse, colname_metric, model_pre_process,
                     include_fanova_total) {
    profile_multiverse(
      multiverses[[multiverse]],
      colname_metric = colname_metric,
      model_pre_process = get(model_pre_process),
      include_fanova_total = include_fanova_total,
      n_runs = N_RUNS
    ) |>
      mutate(multiverse = multiverse, .before = 1)
  }) |>
  left_join(mv_meta |> select(multiverse, n_universes, n_decisions), by = "multiverse") |>
  mutate(
    multiverse = factor(multiverse, levels = multiverse_levels),
    method = factor(
      method,
      levels = c("regression", "decide", "fanova_main", "fanova_total")
    ),
    method_label = factor(nn(as.character(method)), levels = nn(levels(method)))
  )
```

## Results

### Timing table (median seconds)

```{r profiling-table-wide}
profiling_results |>
  select(multiverse, method_label, time_median) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = method_label, values_from = time_median) |>
  arrange(multiverse)
```

### Clean table

```{r profiling-table}
#| echo: false
profiling_latex <- profiling_results |>
  transmute(
    multiverse,
    method_label,
    n_universes,
    cell = fmt_time(time_median)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method_label, values_from = cell,
    names_sort = TRUE
  ) |>
  arrange(multiverse) |>
  mutate(
    n_universes = scales::label_comma(accuracy = 1)(n_universes),
    across(where(is.character), ~ replace_na(.x, "--"))
  ) |>
  select(multiverse, n_universes,
         Regression, DECIDE, `fANOVA (main)`, `fANOVA (total)`)

profiling_kbl <- knitr::kable(
  profiling_latex,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  escape = TRUE,
  linesep = "",
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = paste0(
    "Median execution time per method and multiverse, over ", N_RUNS,
    " runs. Dashes mark methods not evaluated for a given multiverse."
  ),
  label = "profiling-timings",
  col.names = c("Multiverse", "Universes", "Regression", "DECIDE", "Main", "Total")
) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(
    c(" " = 4, "fANOVA" = 2)
  )

# Also write the table to the tables dir, mirroring compose_importance_table().
local({
  tables_dir <- here::here("tables")
  if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  tex_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "profiling-timings.tex")
  writeLines(as.character(profiling_kbl), tex_path)
  message("Wrote ", tex_path)
})

profiling_kbl
```

### Full table

```{r profiling-table-long}
profiling_results |>
  arrange(multiverse, desc(time_median)) |>
  transmute(
    multiverse,
    method = method_label,
    n_universes,
    median = fmt_time(time_median),
    range = paste0(fmt_time(time_min), " - ", fmt_time(time_max)),
    n_runs
  )
```

### Execution time by method and multiverse

```{r profiling-bar}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(
  profiling_results,
  aes(x = time_median, y = fct_rev(method_label), fill = method)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = time_min, xmax = time_max)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = fmt_time(time_median)),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ multiverse, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", end = 0.9, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Median execution time (seconds)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Method execution speed across multiverses"
  )
```

### Comparison by multiverse

```{r profiling-bar-grouped}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(
  profiling_results,
  aes(x = time_median, y = fct_rev(multiverse), fill = method_label)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", end = 0.9) +
  labs(
    x = "Median execution time (seconds)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Method"
  )
```

### Heatmap

```{r profiling-heatmap}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5
profiling_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = method_label, y = fct_rev(multiverse), fill = time_median)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt_time(time_median), colour = time_median > 3), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "rocket", direction = -1, transform = "log10",
    labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "white"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Median\ntime (s)",
    title = "Execution time (log-scaled fill)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Scaling with multiverse size

```{r profiling-scaling}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(
  profiling_results,
  aes(x = n_universes, y = time_median, colour = method_label, group = method_label)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(drop0trailing = TRUE)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "mako", end = 0.9) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of universes (log scale)",
    y = "Median execution time (seconds, log scale)",
    colour = "Method"
  )
```

## Summary

```{r profiling-summary}
profiling_results |>
  group_by(method = method_label) |>
  summarise(
    min = fmt_time(min(time_median)),
    median = fmt_time(median(time_median)),
    max = fmt_time(max(time_median)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(method)
```
